paragraphs.text: Sign in to ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot and other subscription model routes inside the DeepSeek Harness

# dsh-subscription-signin
**The sign-in button the DeepSeek Harness never shipped.**

Use the AI subscriptions you already pay for — ChatGPT Plus/Pro, Claude Pro/Max,
GitHub Copilot, and

more — as model routes inside the
DeepSeek Harness. Adds a
**Subscriptions** settings page plus a c

ompact extension on every provider card
in **Settings → Models**.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

No password is ever collected or stored by this plugin. The vendor runs the
sign-in on its own page;
the Harness credential store writes the token.
## Repository layout

The **installable package is the `dsh-subscription-signin/` directory.** The
tests, license and docu
mentation sit beside it and are not part of the package:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Why this exists

The Harness already ships everything needed to *use* a subscription as a model
route. Its LLM adapte

r registers OAuth flows for eight providers — the transport
works, the token exchange works, the cre
dential store works.

What it has no surface for is **starting** one. Nothing in the GUI or CLI ever
calls the authorizati
on seam's `begin()`. This plugin is that missing surface.

It implements **no OAuth**. It does not touch PKCE, state, device codes, or token
parsing — all of t

hat lives in `@earendil-works/pi-ai`, shipped by DeepSeek. This
plugin asks the Harness to begin a f

low, shows you the URL and code, and reports
the result.
## Supported providers
Configured out of the box, driven through the Harness's own authorization seam:
| Provider | Credential | Login style |

| ChatGPT (Codex) | `llm-pi-ai/openai-codex` | device code |
| Claude (Pro/Max) | `llm-pi-ai/anthrop

ic` | OAuth |
| GitHub Copilot | `llm-pi-ai/github-copilot` | device code |
| xAI | `llm-pi-ai/xai`

| device code |
| Meta | `llm-pi-ai/meta` | device code |
| OpenRouter | `llm-pi-ai/openrouter` | OA

uth + paste fallback |
| Radius | `llm-pi-ai/radius` | browser callback |
| Kimi For Coding | `llm-p
i-ai/kimi-coding` | device code |

**Honest status.** Sign-in is verified end to end for **ChatGPT (Codex)** and
**Claude (Pro/Max)**;

Claude's route was observed authenticating successfully and
then being rate-limited by the account (

HTTP 429 with Anthropic's own
`request_id` — a quota answer, not a credential failure). Copilot's fl

ow is
verified and completes. xAI, Meta, OpenRouter, Radius and Kimi hold credentials
that have been

written successfully, but **no request has been served on those
routes in the session where this wa

s verified**, so treat them as untested rather
than broken. `docs/FINDINGS.md` records what is measu
red versus inferred.
## Install

**Requirements.** DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` or later. Developed and verified
against `0.2.0-rc.2

`, the release this plugin's two seams were checked on
(`ctx.authorization` from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-a

uthorization`, and the client
`slots` service). Every Harness service it consumes is reached with a

defensive
`ctx.get(...)` plus an undefined check, so a missing one degrades to a reported
message in

stead of a crash — but a Harness that has moved a seam will still need
a matching plugin release.

The plugin is installed into a Harness **profile** as a bundle. Point the plugin
manager at this dir

gin is installed into a Harness **profile** as a bundle. Point the plugin
manager at this directory:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Or, if you publish/consume it as a package, install by name and add it to your
profile's bundle list

r, if you publish/consume it as a package, install by name and add it to your
profile's bundle list:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Then **restart DSH once.** This matters and is explained under
Troubleshooting — the client half is

composed into the
browser's boot graph at startup, so a freshly installed bundle has no page until
t
he process restarts.
## Use
From the GUI: **Settings → Subscriptions**, pick an account, press *Sign in*.

For an agent, or a headless harness, the same implementation is exposed as a tool
with actions `stat

us`, `start`, `poll`, `cancel`, `signout`, `submitCode` and
`diagnostics`. Read `status` first; `sta

rt` returns the URL and, for device
grants, the code you enter on the vendor's page.
## Safety

This section is the reason to trust the plugin, so it is specific rather than
reassuring.

**It never sees a secret.** No password, token, API key or refresh token is read,
written, logged, o

r forwarded. The token is produced and stored by the Harness
credential seam (`ctx.authorization` /

`ctx.credentials`), not by this code.
Audit it yourself — it is two files:

- **`host.js`** — zero imports. No filesystem access, no network requests, no
child processes. It as

ks the credential store *whether* a record exists, and
can delete one on explicit `signout` with `co

nfirm: true`; it never reads a
token value. The one `process.env` write is the documented per-accoun

t `env`
field (used so a provider that selects its endpoint from the environment can be
configured p

er account), and it is restored when the attempt settles.
- **`client.js`** — one dependency, `react

`, supplied by the page. Its only
`fetch` calls go to the plugin's own `/plugins/subscription-signin

` route on
your local Harness. Nothing is rendered from a credential.

**The one network-bearing route is trust-gated.** The panel reaches the Host half
over an HTTP route

that inherits the Harness's own checks
(`connection.requestRejection`: Host/Origin validation and b

rowser
authentication). On top of that, every mutating call must be a JSON `POST`, which
forces a CO

RS preflight and blocks form-based CSRF; bodies are capped at 64 KiB;
responses are `no-store` + `no

light and blocks form-based CSRF; bodies are capped at 64 KiB;
responses are `no-store` + `nosniff`.

**Not sanctioned by the vendors — read this.** For ChatGPT-plan usage, the
Harness targets the ChatG

PT/Codex backend
(`chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex`), which OpenAI's developer documentation tells
thi

rd-party apps not to target for plan usage. **This plugin surfaces behaviour
the Harness already shi

ps; it does not introduce it and cannot change it.** The
sanctioned path for third-party apps is *Si

gn in with ChatGPT*, which the Harness
